latin: Tantus est numerus hymnorum Orphei, quantus est numerus cum quo deus triplex creauit saeculum, sub quaternarii pythagorici forma numeratus.
translation: The Orphic hymns number exactly as many as the number the threefold god used in creating the world, a number reckoned by the method of the Pythagorean quaternary.
